scheme_name: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)
other_conditions: Students must have secured top ranks at the State or District level in Gujarat for Standard X or Standard XII across all streams.
benefits_summary: Cash prizes are awarded to the top three SC students in Standard X and XII at both state and district levels, with amounts ranging from ₹41,000 to ₹11,000 at the state level and ₹6,000 to ₹4,000 at the district level.
